speech.heard: Myanmar has 0.6% of children under five overweight. In Australia, it is 26.4%. Australia has 44 times the percentage recorded in Myanmar. China has 11.1% of young children overweight, while Brazil sits at 10.9%. USA has 9.7%, and the UK hits 7.8%. India stays low at 3.7%. Myanmar is the world's lowest at 0.6%. Where does your country land?
